visualCharacteristics.purpose: Embedded video (YouTube, Vimeo, Brightcove or mp4) with optional poster image
visualCharacteristics.layout: 16:9 frame; poster with centred play button loads the player on click; without a poster the player lazy-loads when scrolled into view

contentPattern.structure: Row 1: poster image (optional); Row 2: link to the video URL. Poster and link may also share one cell

reuseGuidance: Use for any single embedded video. Add a poster image for click-to-play.
